description: This file contains core thread primitives for ARM Cortex-M architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including thread creation, context setup, stack guard configuration, user mode transition, and main thread switching.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Initializes a new thread context, setting up the stack frame and register values for ARM Cortex-M.

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Transitions execution to user mode with specified entry point and parameters.

methods.name: arch_switch_to_main_thread
methods.description: Switches execution to the main thread, setting up stack pointers and enabling interrupts.

methods.name: z_check_thread_stack_fail
methods.description: Checks if a memory fault is due to thread stack corruption based on fault address and current PSP.

methods.name: configure_builtin_stack_guard
methods.description: Configures the ARM built-in stack guard by setting the PSPLIM register for a thread.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables floating point capabilities for the current thread.

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Stub function; floating point enable is not supported on Cortex-M.
